//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the TABS CONTAINER — the `.pa-tabs` block (keen `PureAdmin.Components.Navigation.tabs/1`, svelte `navigation/Tabs.svelte`). SCOPE = CONTAINER ONLY. A tabs component's buttons + panels come from SEPARATE sub-components (keen tab_item/tab_panel/tabs_content/tabs_container/tabs_vertical_layout, svelte TabItem/TabPanel/TabsContent/TabsContainer) fed through the slot. The harness slot receives plain TEXT (the dumper HTML-escapes it), so item/panel markup can't flow through; the body area is a bare text token. This fixture proves ONLY what the `.pa-tabs` container itself emits: its tag, its base class, every style/size/align/overflow/border-top/wrap-labels MODIFIER, and class passthrough. Per-ITEM (__item/__item--active), per-PANEL (__content/__panel), LAYOUT-WRAPPER (__container--*/__vertical-layout--*) and OVERFLOW-MENU (__overflow*) element classes are DEFERRED (prose — their defining sub-components are out of scope). The scrollable overflow variant is capability-covered (the enum option is declared + the pa-tabs--scrollable modifier is claimed) but has NO strict scenario: keen's scrollable SSR shell wraps the slot in .pa-tabs__scroll-container + start/end .pa-tabs__scroll-btn arrows, while svelte's Tabs.svelte emits the slot flat — an irreconcilable-by-design SSR shell, so the __scroll-* element classes are listed in cssStateElements. See README 'container-only' + 'absorbed API divergence'.

propsVocabulary.body: the tab row's content — filled with plain slot text in this container-only slice (real pa-tabs__item children are the deferred sub-components)
propsVocabulary.style: underline(default, no class) | pills | boxed | vertical — the tab visual style
propsVocabulary.size: sm | lg — compact / generous item padding
propsVocabulary.align: centered | full — center the row, or distribute items full-width
propsVocabulary.overflow: nowrap | scrollable | collapse — row overflow handling. scrollable is enum-declared for completeness but has no strict scenario (see top note)
propsVocabulary.borderTop: boolean — active indicator on the TOP border instead of the bottom (pa-tabs--border-top). API DIVERGENCE absorbed: svelte models this as isBorderTop (bool); keen folds it into its style enum as style="border-top". Both emit pa-tabs--border-top; the maps absorb the spelling (card `stat` precedent — svelte bool / keen const).
propsVocabulary.wrapLabels: boolean — let long tab TITLES wrap to multiple lines (pa-tabs--wrap-labels). svelte wrapLabels; keen is_wrap_labels.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions: Structural only — the tabs container adds no attribute conventions (unlike button's type). The body slot is a plain text token (Body) so the diff checks the container's tag + class + nesting, not rich item content. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability. keen's tabs/1 emits id={@id} (nil → omitted) and data-tabs-scroll only when overflow=scrollable (not exercised), so neither leaks into a strict golden.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. All 12 pa-tabs--* block modifiers are claimed here (style×3 + borderTop + size×2 + align×2 + overflow×3 + wrapLabels). capability.mjs axis-1 reverse-check is scoped to block modifiers (pa-tabs--*). Element classes (pa-tabs__*) belong to the deferred sub-components (prose) or, for the scrollable SSR shell, to cssStateElements.

style.note: underline is the default (no class); border-top is a SEPARATE feature because svelte spells it as a bool, not a style enum option

overflow.note: scrollable has no strict scenario — keen's SSR shell wraps the slot in __scroll-container + __scroll-btn arrows while svelte emits it flat (irreconcilable shell). The modifier class is still claimed here and both maps declare the option; the __scroll-* elements are in cssStateElements.

body.note: structural — the container's inner content; item/panel structure is the deferred sub-components

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

deferred.//: Element classes of the pa-tabs block whose DEFINING sub-components are out of this container-only slice. Prose deferrals (acknowledged out-of-scope, unverified) — the sub-components (keen tab_item/tab_panel/tabs_content/tabs_container/tabs_vertical_layout, svelte TabItem/TabPanel/TabsContent/TabsContainer) are the deferred children and are not part of this fixture.
deferred.pa-tabs__item: tab BUTTON — keen tab_item/1, svelte TabItem.svelte (deferred child sub-component).
deferred.pa-tabs__item--active: active tab button — keen tab_item is_active, svelte TabItem (deferred child).
deferred.pa-tabs__content: panel-area wrapper — keen tabs_content/1, svelte TabsContent.svelte (deferred child).
deferred.pa-tabs__panel: tab PANEL — keen tab_panel/1, svelte TabPanel.svelte (deferred child).
deferred.pa-tabs__panel--active: active panel — keen tab_panel is_active, svelte TabPanel (deferred child).
deferred.pa-tabs__container--bordered: horizontal layout wrapper — keen tabs_container/1 (deferred sibling component), svelte TabsContainer.svelte.
deferred.pa-tabs__container--card: card-header layout wrapper — keen tabs_container/1 (deferred sibling), svelte TabsContainer.svelte.
deferred.pa-tabs__vertical-layout: vertical layout wrapper — keen tabs_vertical_layout/1 (deferred sibling), svelte TabsContainer.svelte.
deferred.pa-tabs__vertical-layout--bordered: bordered vertical layout wrapper — keen tabs_vertical_layout/1 (deferred sibling).
deferred.pa-tabs__overflow: card-header overflow wrapper — author/JS-supplied inside the card-header layout; not emitted by tabs/1 itself (deferred).

cssStateElements.//: The scrollable-overflow SSR scaffold. keen's tabs/1 emits these inline when overflow=scrollable (wrapping the slot in a scroll-container between start/end arrow buttons whose --visible state is JS-driven); svelte's Tabs.svelte emits the slot flat with no scaffold. Because the two SSR shells diverge BY DESIGN there is no shared strict golden for scrollable — these elements are therefore out of the strict-compare surface, listed here rather than left as blind spots. The pa-tabs--scrollable BLOCK modifier is still claimed by the overflow enum feature (axis-1) and declared by both maps (axis-2).
cssStateElements.pa-tabs__scroll-btn: start/end scroll arrow button (keen scrollable SSR; svelte omits)
cssStateElements.pa-tabs__scroll-container: horizontal scroll wrapper around the items (keen scrollable SSR; svelte omits)

scenarios.name: basic
scenarios.note: The blessed default container: a <div class="pa-tabs"> (underline style = no modifier). Both wrappers default to this.

scenarios.name: border-top
scenarios.note: svelte isBorderTop (bool) / keen style="border-top" (const) — the maps absorb the spelling; both emit pa-tabs--border-top.

scenarios.name: extra-class
scenarios.note: Class passthrough — the extra class is appended after pa-tabs; token order is normalized away.

scenarios.name: combo
scenarios.note: Modifiers compose on one container; class-token order is normalized away.
